Normal latency
Adds a switch that turns off low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay, fewer rebuffers on weak connections. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.
Remove tracking permissions
Removes advertising ID, ad attribution and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.
Seek interval

Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background audio. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.
